en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone memorial set in a wooded park. The monument is built from rough rocks with a central smooth plaque and a round portrait medallion at the top, all behind an ornate metal fence with spear‑shaped and cross‑topped bars. Dense trees and shrubs surround the structure. The main plaque carries a long German inscription and the year 1888 at the bottom.
